conviction_note: The three findings sum to -5.0; I emit -4.0 because this name's own eight comparable falls rose half the time (median next close -0.42%) and the cross-sectional mean for the -25..-15 drop band is +0.27%, so the reaction function takes a point off a research read that is otherwise one-directional. Both legs point the same way: the primary document is weaker than the headline it was sold under, an already-disclosed licensor obligation is triggered by the very data that caused the fall, and an effective $300m shelf plus a live ATM sit under a company that has just told the market it intends to start a registrational trial it cannot fund.

cause.label: clinical_or_binary_readout
cause.what_happened: Cue Biopharma released Phase 2 CUE-221 topline in chronic spontaneous urticaria on Sunday 2026-09-20 and hosted the call at 08:00 ET on 2026-09-21; the stock gapped UP 3.91% on the 'positive topline' headline and then fell 26.57% intraday as the market worked through the actual tables, which show only a 13-point week-12 separation over the omalizumab comparator arm and rest the differentiation claim on a post hoc week-28 analysis against n=17.

evidence.claim: 8-K items 7.01/8.01/9.01 filed 08:00:17 ET on 2026-09-21 announcing positive Phase 2 topline for CUE-221 in CSU, conducted in China by Genesis Life Sciences, an affiliate of Ascendant Health Ltd, with a conference call at 8:00 a.m. ET the same morning.

Primary endpoint HSS7=0 at week 12: CUE-221 4 mg/kg 54% (n=35) against omalizumab 300 mg 41% (n=17) and placebo 11% (n=18); the omalizumab arm was 'Not Tested'. Key secondary UAS7=0 at week 12: 46% against omalizumab 29%, p<0.05 versus placebo only.

The company's own words for the differentiation claim: 'post hoc analysis at Week 28 demonstrated a statistically significant difference versus omalizumab (delta = 36%)' - post hoc, twelve weeks off drug, against a 17-patient comparator arm.

The press release headline framing the market gapped up on: 'Cue Biopharma Announces Positive Topline Results... Clinically different efficacy profile observed relative to XOLAIR (omalizumab)... establish CUE-221 as a potential best therapeutic option'.

pipeline.next_dated_event: None inside the window. The only dated thing already happened - the 08:00 ET 2026-09-21 call. Full data is promised 'at an upcoming scientific meeting' with no date, the FDA's review of data sufficiency has no date, the food-allergy IND is 'recently submitted' with no stated date so no 30-day clock can be placed, and the next FINRA short-interest dissemination (09-15 settlement) falls around 2026-09-24, outside the window.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A Form 4 cluster of open-market insider buying filed into the window - this management bought 9 times on the open market in the last 3 months and the trading window reopened the moment the topline became public - or a company statement putting a near date on the full dataset presentation.

positioning_check: 318,420 shares short at the 2026-08-31 settlement, 1.76 days to cover, -2.8% versus the 2026-08-14 settlement; that is 4.4% of the 7,264,414 shares outstanding as of 2026-08-12 (10-Q cover page). FINRA publishes about eight business days after settlement, so the position carried INTO the 09-21 fall is not observable and the 09-15 settlement disseminates around 09-24, outside the window. There is no short squeeze here and no crowding to unwind. Skew says nothing: the chain is unusable, ATM legs not two-sided, total open interest 425, put/call OI ratio 0. Insiders: 9 open-market buys against 4 sells in 3 months (Nasdaq insider-trades summary), and the CEO personally bought into the May 2026 private placement at $11.00 per pre-funded warrant. findings.finding: The primary document is weaker than the headline it was sold under: the week-12 primary endpoint separates CUE-221 from the omalizumab arm by 13 points untested, the 'fundamental difference' claim is explicitly post hoc at week 28 against a 17-patient comparator, and the 46% week-12 UAS7=0 sits at or below the 51% barzolvolimab published in a 208-patient Phase 2 that is already in Phase 3.
findings.mechanism_in_window: A wider audience reads the document, and it reads the other way. The 8:00 ET call audience traded the slides; the overnight and next-morning audience reads Exhibit 99.1 and the 8-K tables themselves, where the words 'post hoc', 'Not Tested' and N=17 appear, and can set 46% against Celldex's published 51% at the same timepoint. The document does not rescue the headline - it explains the fall and argues it was not big enough. Dated: the 8-K has been on EDGAR since 08:00:17 ET on 2026-09-21 and is readable by anyone before the 2026-09-22 open.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name's eight comparable falls in 3 years split 4 up / 4 down with a median next close of -0.42% and a median absolute move of 6.45%, so a document-reading finding on this stock has historically been worth about a point, not a leg. The one comparable fall that kept going hardest, 2026-04-21 (-21.18% then -13.43%), was also a company-disclosure day.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken 'the data is not as good as the headline'. It has not taken the competitive benchmark, which is not in any Cue document: the market has to go and find that an anti-KIT antibody already in two Phase 3 studies reported 51% UAS7=0 at the same week-12 timepoint in five times the patients, which makes the phrase 'potential best therapeutic option' unsupportable rather than merely optimistic. If the close had held that, the release would not have been read as establishing a franchise at all and the stock would not have gapped up 3.91% on it in the first place.
findings.independence: Celldex's own published barzolvolimab Phase 2 week-12 result (up to 51% UAS7=0, n=208) and its two registered Phase 3 studies: https://ir.celldex.com/news-releases/news-release-details/celldex-therapeutics-presents-positive-12-week-results and https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06455202

findings.finding: The positive Phase 2 readout is itself a trigger under the Ascendant licence and purchase agreements - up to $205.0m of development and regulatory milestones payable 'including upon receipt of threshold data from a specified Phase 2 clinical trial', plus a Top-Up Obligation to issue Ascendant shares or pre-funded warrants taking it to no less than 7.5% of outstanding stock with a $15.0m value floor and explicitly no cap - and that obligation is disclosed only in a 10-Q footnote, not in the release that moved the stock.
findings.mechanism_in_window: A wider audience reads a second document alongside the first. The trial that produced the data was run in China by Genesis Life Sciences, an affiliate of Ascendant, so a reader who opens the 2026-08-14 10-Q Notes 2, 3 and 8 next to the 2026-09-21 8-K can compute that 'positive Phase 2 topline' means cash out of a ~$67m pro-forma cash box and a variable-share issuance to the licensor. Both documents have been public since before the drop-day close; only their combination is new, and it takes one overnight read. If a Top-Up Milestone was in fact achieved on 2026-09-20, an Item 3.02 8-K is due within four business days, which starts the clock inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last time this company's Ascendant obligations were marked, the accounting itself was punitive: a $90.0m loss on issuance of liability-classified warrants in Q2 2026 because the stock rose between pricing and closing, and $35.1m of Q2 R&D expense from the licence of which $20.1m was the non-cash fair value of Ascendant pre-funded warrants and the related top-up obligations. The 2026-04-21 (-21.18%) and 2026-04-28 (-30.54%) falls sit in the same window as the Ascendant deal and the 1-for-30 reverse split.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken the efficacy read. It has not taken the fact that the company owes money and stock for that efficacy read. The Top-Up mechanic is a variable-share obligation with no dollar cap - the more the programme succeeds, the more of the company Ascendant gets - and that is not in any headline, any press release or any of Monday's coverage; it is three footnotes deep in a quarterly. If the close held it, the release would have been read as a cost event as well as a data event, and the stock would not have opened up 3.91%.
findings.independence: The 8-K announcing the readout names Genesis Life Sciences as 'an affiliate of Ascendant Health Ltd', which is what connects the trial to the licence obligation: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526396094/d21238d8k.htm

findings.finding: An equity financing can be done inside the window with no board process and no marketing period: a $300m Form S-3 (File 333-294366) declared effective 2026-03-31 and an October 2021 Jefferies open-market sale agreement with about $36.8m of its $80m unused, against 7.26m shares outstanding, roughly $67m of pro-forma cash and a company that has just told the market it is 'working toward the rapid initiation of a Phase 2b/3 study in CSU' plus a Phase 2 in food allergy.
findings.mechanism_in_window: It lands inside the window rather than later because nothing has to be built: the shelf is already effective, the ATM sales agreement is already signed, and an ATM draw requires no filing, no announcement and no investor call. The drop day printed $99.8m of volume against a $4.2m twenty-day median - roughly 45% of the entire share count changed hands in one session - which is the deepest liquidity this stock has ever had to sell into, and the agent can keep selling into 2026-09-22. This issuer has raised twice in ten weeks (May 2026 $27.6m net, July 2026 $49.8m net), so the question is the channel, not the willingness.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025-12-19 fall (-21.64%, then -5.22% the next close) is this stock's own at-the-market day: the baseline's full-text probe puts an 'at-the-market' hit in an 8-K exhibit filed 2025-12-19 and a 424B5 on 2025-12-18. That is the one comparable fall where supply was the identified line, and it continued down the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken the data. It has not taken the cost of acting on the data. A registrational Phase 2b/3 in CSU plus a Phase 2 in food allergy is a multi-hundred-million-dollar programme and the company has about $67m; the release that moved the stock says what it intends to run and says nothing about how it will be paid for. If the close held a financing, the stock would not have been bid up 3.91% at the open on a release whose logical consequence is a raise, and the 46% of market cap that traded on the day would not have been priced as an efficacy debate.
findings.independence: The resale registration for the July 2026 $50m private placement went effective 2026-08-20 (EFFECT notice), freeing 1,418,071 shares plus 87,500 pre-funded warrants held by Cormorant and Columbia Threadneedle - a second, already-open supply channel on the same line: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/999999999526002724/xslEFFECTX01/primary_doc.xml

outside_window.finding: Full Phase 2 dataset including PK and IgE analyses from the 36-week study to be presented 'at an upcoming scientific meeting' - the single biggest swing factor for this name and the company gave it no date, so it cannot be scored here.

FDA review of 'the sufficiency of the data from the Phase 2 clinical trial of CUE-221 in CSU' gates both the planned Phase 2b/3 in CSU and the Phase 2 in food allergy; a China-only trial run by a related party is exactly the bridging question a US registrational path turns on. No date given.

Near-term Ascendant cash milestones outside the big $205m development/regulatory tranche: $5.0m on completion of manufacturing technology transfer and $6.5m on completion of data and know-how transfer. Both are undated and both are cash out of a ~$67m box.

Next FINRA short-interest dissemination, for the 2026-09-15 settlement, publishes about eight business days after settlement - around 2026-09-24. It is the first observation of any position built into the run-up, and it lands after this window closes.

Three CUE-100 series trials remain open with primary completion dates in 2027 and 2031 (NCT06917885, NCT04852328, NCT07172256); none of them can read out inside this window and none of them is the asset that moved the stock.

baseline_tension: It agrees, which is the honest problem with it - 22.5x volume points to -2.44% next session, a 15.4% ATR is the high end of the best free ranker, and a +50.5% twenty-day run-up makes the free control -run_up_20d_pct already strongly negative on this name, so my research is pointing the same way as three things that cost nothing to compute; the one thing that cuts against all of it is this stock's own history, where four of eight comparable falls rose the next close, and that is the point I took off the finding sum.
